regions.region: page 1 title, abstract, author block, and ESI/CCDC footnote
regions.finding: Article identity and aggregate asymmetric semipinacol claim were inspected. The paper advertises ESI/CCDC 980926, but workspace source mapping leaves SI association unestablished; no SI fact was imported.
The R/Ar/X reaction-class drawing is a generic asymmetric semipinacol proposal and is classified as general_scheme, not an experiment-specific preparation.

regions.region: page 1 upper-right Table 1 reaction header, entries 1–8, and footnotes a–b
regions.finding: Eight independent optimization runs were retained with 1a scale, N-bromo-1,8-naphthalimide loading, catalyst/acid presence and loadings, toluene volume, N2/room temperature, row times, isolated yields, and HPLC ee. Signed −8% and −30% source values are preserved as signed selectivity strings rather than invalid negative percentage quantities.

regions.region: page 1 lower-right optimization prose introducing Table 2 entries 1–7
regions.finding: The narrative supports the distinct 4b–4h phosphoric-acid screen shown fully on page 2. Cross-page evidence is linked to those rows; no narrative duplicates were created.

unresolved: The exact identity of the catalytically active species is stated by the authors to be unknown.
No SI association was inferred; workups, purifications, and masses for Table 1 are absent.

regions.region: page 2 upper-left prose and Table 2 reaction header, entries 1–14, footnotes a–g
regions.finding: Fourteen distinct optimization rows were retained. Acid identity, both preincubation periods, catalyst/acid/MeOH loadings, NBS and 1,3-dibromohydantoin substitutions, −30 °C override, row times, isolated yields including ~75%, and HPLC ee are structured row-wise.

regions.region: page 2 upper-right Table 3 reaction header, entries 1–12, and footnotes a–d
regions.finding: Twelve independent R-group scope experiments were retained with shared catalyst/additive/brominating-reagent conditions, 0.5 mmol/10 mL scale except 0.2 mmol 1l, row times, isolated yields, and HPLC ee. The allyl C=C nonreaction is preserved for entry 9.

regions.region: page 2 lower-right Table 4 reaction header, entries 1–5, and footnotes a–d
regions.finding: Five independent aryl-scope experiments were retained with shared standard conditions, row times, isolated yields, and HPLC ee. Footnote d assigns 3o as S and overrides the generic R-3 column heading for that row.
Substituent-specific prose maps to the table rows and was not counted as duplicate experiments. The reported no-reaction at the allylic bond is an outcome note, not a failed whole reaction.

unresolved: Main-text tables omit workups, purifications, isolated masses, and detailed addition operations.
No unprovided SI optimization rows were reconstructed.
Complex catalyst and product stereochemical encodings remain unverified.

regions.region: page 3 upper-left 3k recrystallization prose and Figure 1
regions.finding: Threefold CH2Cl2/n-hexane recrystallization of 3k is retained as a distinct enrichment operation (17%, 99% ee). Figure 1/CCDC 980926 is characterization of R-3k, not another preparation or an SI association.

The 3.0 mmol 1k repeat followed by two recrystallizations is distinct from Table 3 entry 11 and is retained with 882.5 mg substrate, 40% yield, and 94% ee. Referred SI operational details remain missing.

regions.region: page 3 center-left Scheme 2 and accompanying paragraph
regions.finding: Four distinct operations were retained: 5 mmol/17 h 1c→R-3c (1.1428 g, 77%, 74% ee), DNPH/H2SO4 hydrazone formation (92%, 75% ee), CH2Cl2/n-hexane fractionation into 19%/7% ee crystals and 72%/99% ee mother liquor, and 12 M HCl/dioxane hydrolysis at 50 °C for 17.7 h to R-3c (81%, 98% ee).

regions.region: page 3 conclusion, reproduction acknowledgment, references, and crystallographic footnote
regions.finding: The acknowledgment supports existing Table 3 entries 2 and 9 and Table 4 entry 2 but supplies no independent run data, so no duplicate records were created. References are prior literature. Footnote 5 says compound 2 followed a literature synthesis but gives no current-paper procedure.

unresolved: The large-scale 1k operational details are referred only to unassociated ESI.
Several recrystallization/hydrazone/hydrolysis solvent volumes, masses, workups, purifications, and analytical bases are absent.
Crystallography supports the source assignment but does not certify candidate machine structures.
